import ast,hashlib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
root=Path('D:/Physim');out=root/'docs/visuals/f1-layouts/figure-font-2026-10-21'
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p,lf=False):
    b=p.read_bytes();return hashlib.sha256(b.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n') if lf else b).hexdigest()
rel=lambda p:p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
d=load(out/'validation.json');checks={}
for bank,lf in [('source_sha256_lf',True),('foreign_sha256_lf',True),('font_assets_sha256',False)]:
    for p,h in d['sources']['86'][bank].items():assert sha(root/p,lf)==h,p
    checks[bank]=len(d['sources']['86'][bank])
for p,h in d['references'].items():assert sha(root/p)==h,p
for r in d['runs']:
    assert sha(root/r['path'])==r['sha256']
    assert load(root/r['path'])==r['records']
    if r['source']==86:assert r['passed']==r['total']
assert len(d['runs'])==8
assert all(v['count']==8 for v in d['final_unique_scope'].values())
for scope in d['final_unique_scope'].values():assert sha(root/scope['binary']['path'])==scope['binary']['sha256']
for image in d['images']:
    p=root/image['path'];source=root/image['source'];assert sha(p)==image['sha256'] and sha(source)==image['source_sha256']
    b=Image.open(p).convert('RGB').tobytes();assert b==Image.open(source).convert('RGB').tobytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==image['rgb_sha256']
for scope in d['native_h'].values():
    assert sha(root/scope['path'])==scope['sha256']
    assert len(scope['figure_font_records'])==28 and all(r[1]=='1' for r in scope['figure_font_records'])
assert sha(root/d['linux_h']['path'])==d['linux_h']['sha256']
assert d['linux_h']['record']['status']=='passed' and d['linux_h']['record']['app_deadline_seconds']==60
assert len(d['parity'])==112 and all(p['article_equal'] and p['outside_figure_equal'] for p in d['parity'])
for platform in ('windows','linux'):assert sum(bool(p['full_difference']) for p in d['parity'] if p['platform']==platform)==28
for r in d['font_manifest']['files']:
    p=root/'third_party/fonts'/r['file'];assert p.stat().st_size==r['bytes'] and sha(p)==r['sha256']
for r in d['build_logs']:assert sha(root/r['path'])==r['sha256']
for r in d['execution_sources']:assert sha(root/r['path'])==r['sha256'] and (root/r['path']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')==r['source']
assert sha(root/d['generator']['path'])==d['generator']['sha256']
assert (root/d['generator']['path']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')==d['generator']['source']
cleanup=load(out/'cleanup.json');assert cleanup['status']=='completed'
assert cleanup['count']==len(cleanup['files'])==34
assert cleanup['bytes']==sum(f['bytes'] for f in cleanup['files'])==32883362
assert all(not (root/f['path']).exists() for f in cleanup['files'])
owned=['app/documentation_figure_font.inc','app/documentation_h.inc','app/documentation_h_tests.inc','app/documentation_keyboard_tests.inc','app/documentation_typography.inc','app/documentation_window.inc','app/main.c','tests/check_display_workflow.py','third_party/fonts/README.md','third_party/fonts/manifest.json','third_party/fonts/NotoSerif-Italic.ttf','third_party/fonts/notoserifitalic-OFL.txt']
docs=[root/'docs/visuals/f1-layouts'/p for p in ('SVG-LABELS.md','H-FIDELITY.md','NEXT-CHAT.md')]
docs.extend(root/'docs/visuals/unified-workspace'/p for p in ('README.md','NATIVE-FIDELITY.md'))
links=0
for p in docs:
    text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8');assert 'Ã' not in text and 'Â' not in text
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
        if re.match(r'\w+://',target) or target.startswith('#'):continue
        file=(p.parent/target.split('#')[0].split('?')[0]).resolve()
        if file==out/'audit.json':continue
        assert file.exists(),(p,target);links+=1
for p in out.glob('*.json'):load(p)
ast.parse((root/'tests/check_display_workflow.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
result=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check','--',*owned,*map(rel,docs)],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True);assert result.returncode==0,result.stdout+result.stderr
checks.update(terminal_build_runs=8,additional_linux_h=True,native_pngs=16,article_and_outside_figure_pairs=112,changed_model_images_per_platform=28,font_manifest_entries=len(d['font_manifest']['files']),local_doc_links=links,cleanup_completed=True,json_syntax=True,python_syntax=True,git_diff_check=True,foreign_changes_unchanged=True)
audit=dict(scope='Bounded source/proof/asset self-audit; full H and whole UI still open.',checks=checks,owned_files=owned,inputs=[dict(path=rel(p),sha256=sha(p)) for p in [out/'validation.json',out/'cleanup.json',*docs]],manual_review=['SVG font sources and bounded ranges retain unchanged ASCII upload invariants.','Candidate commit occurs only after successful bake/upload; prior handles are retained on failure.','Queued scaled draw font is persistent app state, not stack storage; same native sanitizer cases now pass.','Figure roles and scaled draw state are reset with density replacement/window destruction.','Only model-label drawing changes; all112 images are identical outside the model rectangle.','Offline font and license are pinned and stored in existing packaged font directory.'],generator=dict(path=rel(Path(__file__)),sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
(out/'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(audit,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(checks))
